issues.body: The final parenthetical still says this is "the same anonymous-class output-vocabulary gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005". That comparison remains unsupported by the taxonomy in this diff: New-Feature-SelfRestriction-002 reaches an in-profile anonymous hasSelf concept internally and fails when the realiser cannot emit a ClassAssertion to its restriction bnode, whereas WebOnt-I5.5-005 relies on owl:unionOf/list vocabulary outside EL and is skipped before the relevant concept is processed. Both conclusions may contain anonymous structure, but their blocking mechanisms are not the same.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the final comparison to WebOnt-I5.5-005, or explicitly contrast the mechanisms: this hasSelf case is an in-profile anonymous-restriction reification/output gap, while WebOnt-I5.5-005 is blocked because owl:unionOf and its list structure are outside EL and skipped.
issues.title: The hasSelf output gap is still incorrectly equated with WebOnt-I5.5-005

verdict.summary: Round 4's documentation finding remains materially unchanged. The revised taxonomy correctly identifies anonymous-class output as a distinct output-vocabulary limitation, and the entry accurately explains that CRs3 now derives the hasSelf concept internally. However, the final parenthetical still calls this the same gap as WebOnt-I5.5-005, even though that case is blocked earlier by owl:unionOf/list vocabulary being outside EL and skipped. Because the same minor accuracy issue remains at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
